title: Remote service permits
text: Remote service visits do not require a permit. The service fee is 25 dollars per visit.

title: Office service permits
text: Office service visits require a permit. The service fee is 60 dollars per visit.

title: Amber order returns
text: Amber order returns use form R-27. The return deadline is 12 calendar days after delivery. Refunds have a 40 dollar processing fee.

title: Violet order returns
text: Violet order returns use form R-270. The return deadline is 21 calendar days after delivery. Refunds have a 140 dollar processing fee.

title: Opal incident escalation
text: An Opal incident must be acknowledged within 8 minutes. If unresolved after 24 minutes, route OPAL-P2 pages the duty coordinator.

title: Aster API retries
text: Aster create requests send the Replay-Key header. Keys remain valid for 6 hours. Reusing a key with different request content returns HTTP 422.

title: Birch record retention
text: Birch audit records are retained for 9 years. Birch support transcripts are retained for 9 months.

title: Cedar evidence uploads
text: Cedar evidence must arrive within 11 calendar days. The required upload format is PNG under 8 MB. PDF uploads are not accepted.

title: Maple parcel delivery
text: Maple parcels ship on Monday and Friday. A missed delivery must be rescheduled before 3 PM local time.

title: Quartz emergency access
text: Quartz emergency access uses code QZ-73. Approval from three on-call managers is required. Credentials expire after 45 minutes.

title: Iris archive storage
text: Iris primary archives are stored in Oslo. The failover location is Bergen. Backups never leave Norway.

title: Copper payment settlement
text: Copper domestic transfers settle within 3 business days. Copper international transfers settle within 7 business days.
